ينهمك (form VII)
# يَنْهَمِكُ (yanhamiku) /jan.ha.mi.ku/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
# يَنْهَمِكَ (yanhamika) /jan.ha.mi.ka/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
# يَنْهَمِكْ (yanhamik) /jan.ha.mik/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
